name: Pressure
author: Airwindows (Chris Johnson, MIT licence)
description: Airwindows Pressure4 by Chris Johnson: a vari-mu style compressor that clamps down on peaks and lets go smoothly, with a soft clip after it so nothing goes over. Ported from Airwindows (MIT licence).
code:
// Airwindows Pressure4, Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson, MIT licence (LICENSE-airwindows.txt) - ported to Central FX
@init
sp = 10000
co = 1
@block
os = srate / 44100
th = 1 - pressure * 0.95
mk = 1 / th
rel = pow(1.28 - speed, 5) * 32768 / os
fa = sqrt(rel)
mw = abs(mu)
um = 1 - mw
pm = mu >= 0
go = db2gain(output)
@sample
xl = inL * mk
xr = inR * mk
se = max(abs(xl), abs(xr))
if (se > th) {
  mv = th / se
  ma = sqrt(abs(sp))
  co = (co * (ma - 1) + (mv < th ? th : mv)) / ma
} else {
  co = (co * (sp * sp - 1) + 1) / (sp * sp)
}
sp = (sp * (sp - 1) + abs(se * rel) + fa) / sp
c = (pm ? co * co : sqrt(co)) * mw + co * um
xl = xl * c * go
xr = xr * c * go
b = abs(xl)
b = b > 1.57079633 ? 1 : sin(b)
outL = xl > 0 ? b : -b
b = abs(xr)
b = b > 1.57079633 ? 1 : sin(b)
outR = xr > 0 ? b : -b
